body_html:
Let’s Meet Darius!

Also known as DJ D Milli, Darius joins us from Milwaukee Wisconsin!  Darius is an experienced host who loves to entertain his audiences!  “I truly love music and embrace the art of keeping a party live!  No better way to do that than to DJ”.  In his spare time, Darius is a big family guy and keeps family close.  He also likes to skate, and speaking new languages.  Russian is his language of choice right now.

What’s in Darius Headphones?

Depends on my mood, but I love all music!

What’s the Best part about being a DJ?

I get to see people happy and having a good time!
